## What changed and why

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and user-visible outcome.

## Verification

State the result of `npm test` and relevant focused checks. For native changes, record the actual Premiere/UXP/platform versions and tested operations separately from fixtures. If no live check was performed, say so. Review `npm pack --dry-run --json` for distribution changes.

## Risks or blockers

Describe version limits, side effects, uncertain outcomes or remaining release gates. Confirm no implicit save, source-sequence mutation, permission widening or arbitrary code endpoint was introduced, where relevant.

## Linked task

Link a relevant issue or public development plan, or state the acceptance criteria here. Keep internal working TODOs local. Keep local registry IDs, personal paths, project/media names and diagnostic dumps out of the PR body.
